text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.N. special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, is visiting Harare to attend a southern African peacekeeping military exercise.
- New Minister of Territorial Administration, Fernando Muteka, said that extension of the state's administration to all of the national territory was important.
- Angola's Catholic church leaders have given their support for Angola's newly formed unity government and held talks with Prime Minister Fernando van Dunem.
